categories.main_business_segments: Autostreets Development Limited primarily operates in the used vehicle auction business, which is its core segment, complemented by used vehicle value-added services, arrangement for sale of used vehicles, exhibition related services, and other vehicle-related services. The company provides an integrated online-offline auction platform connecting used vehicle buyers and sellers, mainly serving 4S dealership stores and professional buyers. It also launched institutional and quality auction businesses targeting bulk vehicle disposals and high-value vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes an online-offline integrated auction platform with real-time mobile application participation, supported by proprietary technical systems for auction management, risk control, and vehicle inspection. It employs professional vehicle appraisal and evaluation techniques, including blockchain-based evidence storage to ensure transparency and prevent tampering. The company invests in digitalization, data processing, and remote stream control technologies, as evidenced by its R&D activities and granted patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Autostreets serves upstream sellers primarily consisting of 4S dealership stores and OEMs, and downstream buyers mainly comprising professional buyers who purchase multiple used vehicles annually. Institutional clients include operational leasing companies, online vehicle-hailing platforms, logistics companies, and used vehicle exporters. The company also serves consumer trade-in vehicle owners through arrangement for sale services and hosts automotive exhibitions for dealership groups and OEMs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with a network covering 326 cities and partnerships with over 7,800 4S stores. It has auction sites in major cities including Shanghai, Chongqing, Nanchang, Yichang, and others, and plans to expand further. Its principal offices are located in Shanghai, PRC, and Hong Kong, with registered office in the Cayman Islands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Autostreets operates as a midstream intermediary platform in the used vehicle supply chain, connecting upstream sellers (dealerships, OEMs, institutional clients) with downstream buyers (professional buyers, consumers). It facilitates vehicle transactions through auctions and value-added services, acting as an agent in vehicle sales arrangements and providing ancillary services such as inspection, appraisal, and title transfer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding and upgrading its auction network, enhancing upstream and downstream customer bases, diversifying service offerings, and advancing digitalization initiatives. It emphasizes collaboration with new energy vehicle OEMs, improving inspection and appraisal capabilities for new energy used vehicles, and developing institutional and quality auction businesses. R&D investments target technological innovation in auction platform systems, vehicle data processing, and remote stream control, with a commitment to ESG and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Autostreets generates revenue primarily from used vehicle auction commissions and service fees, supplemented by fees from used vehicle value-added services (inspection, appraisal, acquisition assistance, title transfer), arrangement for sale of used vehicles (acting as agent), exhibition related services (booth and advertisement fees), and other vehicle-related services. The revenue is transaction-based, with average revenue per vehicle varying by service segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Autostreets positions itself as a leading used vehicle auction platform in China, pioneering an integrated online-offline auction model and maintaining extensive cooperation with OEMs and dealership groups. It emphasizes its comprehensive service offerings, institutional auction capabilities, and technological innovation to differentiate itself in a competitive market affected by new vehicle price wars and evolving industry dynamics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of RMB 408.6 million, a 16.9% decrease from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 62.4%. It transacted approximately 180,000 used vehicles through auctions and serviced around 206,000 vehicles in value-added services. The company experienced a net loss of RMB 110.6 million in 2024, impacted by decreased auction prices and listing expenses, but adjusted net profit (non-IFRS) was RMB 58.4 million. Total assets were RMB 1.25 billion with equity of RMB 937.5 million, reflecting growth and capital structure improvements post-listing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Autostreets offers a highly standardized, transparent, and efficient used vehicle transaction platform combining online and offline auctions, supported by professional vehicle appraisal and blockchain-based data integrity. It provides end-to-end solutions that optimize transaction processes for sellers and buyers, including institutional clients, with enhanced services such as vehicle delivery and documentation. The company’s focus on digitalization, ESG integration, and collaboration with OEMs, especially in new energy vehicles, differentiates it as a trusted and innovative leader in China’s used vehicle market.
